customer_message.subject: Mould and damp in children's room, help needed
customer_message.body: Hi, I'm writing about a problem in our flat at Mattenweg 13 in St. Gallen. We rent this 2-room flat from Privera Wohnen AG. There are black mould stains and damp patches on the walls in the children's room. I reported it to the landlord in writing in early September. They said someone would come, but nothing has been fixed yet. My son has been having breathing problems, coughing at night and wheezing, and the doctor thinks it could be linked to the damp air in that room. For now we have moved his bed into the living room. I don't want to keep paying full rent for a flat that is making my child sick. I am thinking about paying the rent into the official rent deposit (Hinterlegung) if the defect is not fixed within a reasonable time. Can you tell me what my options are and whether my legal expenses cover this? I can send photos and the doctor's letter if you need them. Thanks, Jordan Reid
